purpose: Frozen research-only tests of whether prior fund performance selects later winners; expanded symbol coverage is not production universe expansion.
holdout_caveat: Historical evaluation, not unseen to the research community or genuinely prospective; do not claim virgin OOS.
rebalance: Score on final observed common US trading close of each calendar year; execute at next observed common daily close; hold target equal-weight top three until next execution, allowing weights to drift between rebalances.
position: LONG only, fully funded, no leverage; cash zero yield; entry/exit at observed adjusted close, no intraday TP/SL; exit at annual rebalance or sample-end valuation
expense_treatment: Adjusted NAV/ETF total-return histories already reflect ongoing fund expenses. Do not subtract current MER again. Historical loads, platform fees, taxes, FX costs and retail availability remain unverified; assumed no-load execution is not universal.
missing_data: No forward/back filling. Require complete benchmark-date coverage for three-year ranking window and next holding year. Dropped assets/years explicitly logged. Using subsequent completeness is a known survivor-selection limitation, not certifiable OOS.
random_control: 500 fixed-seed random top-three baskets from the exact same eligible set each year, same execution dates and costs. Report daily-Sharpe percentile plus plus-one upper-tail p estimate. This is a matched random-selection test, NOT a matched random-entry test.
bootstrap: 2000 fixed-seed circular 21-trading-day block bootstrap of paired daily strategy-minus-benchmark returns on 2016+ evaluation. Lower 95% bound of annualized arithmetic excess mean; selected-survivor evidence cannot certify alpha.
family_trials: Three selectors times three US equity universes = nine planned trials, plus all per-symbol descriptive comparisons. Record all outputs. No DSR/PBO claim without complete historical trial matrix; do not substitute this family count for all repository searches.
benchmark: SPY adjusted total return over exactly matching USD dates; Canadian CAD funds compared only to ZSP.TO in CAD. Mixed bonds/commodities/balanced comparisons are descriptive and cannot imply like-risk alpha.
symbol_durability: For each asset report complete-history daily MTM metrics, exact-start benchmark, 2008/2020/2022 where covered, first/second halves, and annually anchored forward 1/3/5-year return and excess; report overlapping horizons as dependent.

research_screen.label: FAIL unless all screening criteria pass; even a screen pass cannot be MONEY-READY/CANDIDATE without authoritative integrity, trial-adjustment and sealed-forward gates

data_source: Yahoo chart v8 adjusted daily closes, inception-aware. Public retrieval with SHA256 cache. No ETF history before inception. Current-survivor universe is explicitly biased; no point-in-time dead-fund database available.
stopping: Run this frozen family once. No parameter search after seeing returns. Publish all failures. No production orders, universe edits, strategy kills or dashboard generator.
